name: Seambreaker Hounds
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy strategy game animated sprite source. True transparent RGBA background. Exactly four full-body poses of ONE original upgraded Brasshollow creature in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid with equal square cells, wide clear transparent gutters. Painterly richly textured fantasy unit art, weathered brass and soot-black iron, warm directional light. Right-facing three-quarter camera; same identity, design, equipment, proportions and scale in all four cells. Full body and all weapons visible with generous 8% margin EACH cell. Same planted feet/paws positions in every cell. Four genuinely articulated idle keyframes reading row-major, visibly different joint and equipment angles; no static duplicate cutouts. No text, caption, watermark, gridlines, checkerboard, environment, scenery, floor or platform. Creature Seambreaker Hounds. Low armored mechanical canine quadruped with wedge-shaped split forked seam-prying jaws, massive overlapping riveted shoulder plates, twin short dorsal pressure vents, segmented brass tail and exposed blue-black piston legs. No rider, no human. Idle frames: 1 jaws closed head low tail curved down; 2 head lifts at neck hinge and forked jaws slightly open, tail joint lifts; 3 head highest jaws open wider, elbows compress slightly with all paws grounded; 4 head halfway lowered jaws half close tail settling. Clearly articulated neck, jaw hinges, leg pistons and tail. All four complete paws in each frame.
